name: Emirates
verdict: The airline is owned by the Dubai government’s investment arm.

why.text: Dubai is part of the United Arab Emirates. In 2024, a UAE court gave 43 people, including human rights defenders, life sentences after a single mass trial that human rights monitors called unfair. Putting Emirates on a famous shirt makes the country look good to millions of fans while that goes on. That’s called sportswashing.
why.messageLine: In 2024, 43 activists in the UAE got life sentences in one mass trial.
